title: Wool for Wolves
journal_entries: Damian requested for me to join him on a short excursion just outside Raven Spring - with the aim of ridding the fields beyond Grey Belmor of the curse that had haunted the land since the age of Mados.

We depart on this pernicious expedition, the ordinary guard are trepid - most begrudging the venture so to not insult the dead Bretons who fell here. Yet this has not stalled the Ustase; the black hounds of Evermore - who most certainly put coin and status above respect. We are banking on the priest's suspicion of a defunct Direnni well, which activated, that can banish the omen that grips this stretch of land. We have to be quick however, as any phantom we strike down will rise just as quickly as it fell.

A fleshy mound covered the well we had sought, the priest had demonstrated his divine ability and melted the infernal thing till it was naught but dust. Upon Damian's call, I fired this Direnni device at the well, activating its nascent power until the foretold barrier had come to destroy this omen. I will console the party on the matters.
objectives: Meet with the entourage in the Marsh
Protect the Priest while he burns away the fleshy barrier
Use the Staff [Cane of the Incandescent] on the Dirennian Well

title: Forlorn's Eulogy
journal_entries: We routed the Bretons back to their stone walls, were I to know that I'd be engaged in this visceral struggle, I may have stayed in Skyrim. But I feel a thrill, a destiny outside of merely fighting for coin and renown - this is survival.

The Warchief's son was arrogant and dismissive, I fear that we may not get along if we spend any further time with each other. Alas, he is the one to dish out orders instead of his father for the time being - with his first task to retrieve an amulet from a cave. An amulet that he said belonged to the lord of that wretched town which spurned me; Arnima. I don't know the significance of this gaudy relic, though I'm eager to explore.

Malacath's Mettle! This amulet is foul - voices and feelings of despair accost me as I hold it. I should part ways with it immediately by giving it to the Firstborn, maybe this ominous relic can impart some humility onto him.
The firstborn was skeptical on the authenticity of the amulet, yet even he couldn't ignore the twisted allure of it. Conceding to my accomplishment, he told me to speak with his father.
objectives: Speak to the Firstborn for further objectives
Bring the necklace back to the Firstborn
Get a brief on what to do next

title: Remembering the Rubicon
journal_entries: The Warchief told me to meet up with Anka, near Arnima - a plot has been devised to strike right at the heart of that town. We are to sneak into the Lord's manor to assassinate him.

After hearing the disembodied voices engage in a heated argument, calamity struck. The entire sewer system shook from some ferocious force, appearing to stem from outside this squalid durance. I can't return the way I came, I must find another exit to escape.

I've found myself in some nightmare realm of endless red - did I not make it out of their alive? Was I killed in the attempt to save myself? I try to come to my senses, to get a sense of direction in this formless land.

I spoke to this estranged specter; vague ramblings and portents of things to come, however i did glean some information of use. An objective: to climb the mountain before me if I ever hope to see reality again.

Must we fight the royalty from every era and land? This vile king, seemingly formed out of feces and other foul refuse, had exhausted his fork tongue in his attempts to insult me. And when words don't suffice, violence will - I engage in the carnal struggle, yet again.

I was flung back onto the cold, unjust world that I knew - and I was grateful. It is at least a prison I'm familiar with. Immediately before me lays the decapitated corpse of the Warchief - still dazed by my foray into that hellscape, I clamber towards the assumed assailment in hope of answers.
objectives: Enter the sewers and find the Lord
Try to find out where you are
Find a way through the menacing black walls
Reach the top of the tower to escape this realm
Understand what happened by speaking to Luther

title: black and tans
journal_entries: The suspect that I presumed to be the Warchief's killer had professed his innocence, I was keen to believe him. There should be no further bloodshed between Orcs if we are to survive our ordeal, especially with a leader who was just made a corpse. The suspect is called Luther; a diplomat from Daggerfall who speaks on behalf of the Orcs - trying to ameliorate the racial strife between us and the Bretons. He has a speech scheduled soon within Evermore; I am to meet with Anka outside Evermore's sewers to make sure nothing goes wrong during this speech.

There must be some curse that haunts the sewers of this kingdom, always the worst transpires in these wretched tunnels. No time to think of the augurs that trouble us, we have to escape yet again. I hope to not see that red realm of death again.

The outpost is in ruins, desolation leaved its way through our transient dwelling - carving through kin with its fiery scythe. Maybe there are still survivors amongst the carnage, maybe not - yet I know I wouldn't want to be left here with the butchers who delight in our suffering. There is another outpost to the north, a sliver of hope perhaps.
objectives: Make your way to the second encampment

title: Conatus
journal_entries: The firstborn had thrown to the wolves without my say, justifying himself with the extreme conditions that are set against us. Yet I know it's all a ploy, to oust potential challengers to his tyranny. In my waking I find myself within white hole in the earth, struggling to breath through the fine dust that engulfs me. A Breton approaches, telling me of my fate - but my fate is up to Malacath, not any Breton. This quarry has received a seed of reckoning.

I've placed the soul gem within the ancient construct, suffering through the humiliation of excreting it from my bowels. The only way to smuggle something so dangerous into this hole. The Breton's called us the race from feces, but feces had delivered us salvation on this day - to the great shame of the Bretons I hope.

Triumphing over this embodiment of might was not easy, I am still shaking. No other foe had sundered my resolve as much as this dominating agent of oblivion. I return to reality once again, vowing to not get involved in any further affairs with demons. My mind cannot suffer another venture into their lands. Yet there's still some duties to attend to; the death of the prince. Such a blow to the kingdom will surely send it into chaos.

title: Hidden Blade
journal_entries: Having entered the Imperial Embassy proper, I came across a Thalmor agent who seemed preoccupied with a myriad issues. My chance to alleviate his burdens and hopefully derive a reward - now I have a task to locate a fugitive blade. The Blade has been rumored to hiding away in High Rock's dense woodland, northwest of Evermore. I must go and apprehend this fugitive before he evades us again.
I've been asked by the Imperial advisor, Vaeser, to locate an ex-Blade member who has gone into exile and makes camp within a fort nestled in the Kingdom's wilderness.

After talking with the fugitive, I've learned that he has been on the run since the end of the Great War, and that his pursuers were relentless. Feeling pity, I spared him and now return to Vaeser for a reward and closure.
I slew the Blade and now seek the generous reward offered by the Thalmor agent, who stays at the Imperial embassy neighboring Arnima.
objectives: Speak with Vaeser about the contract
Go back to Vaeser and talk of the situation
Go to Naruman for a reward

title: MER DE SANG
journal_entries: I've spoken to Kegor who tasked me in finding out an illusive party and their intentions. They're supposedly helping the Orcs supply themselves and giving them direction on where to strike, the same Orcs that sacked the imperial outpost in The Reach, "Orsinium's Sons". Kegor also told me to not be seen by anyone in the Orc camp, and to just listen in on the conversation that may take place.

I listened in on the discussion and escaped without killing the agent, they talked of attacking the small hamlet of Dunlain Falls, and the Orc described his sadistic methods of instilling fear within the Bretons of the land. The helping party seemed to be a part of the Thalmor, I will return to Kegor with the news.

I was spotted by the party, and they assailed my position. I had no option but to defend myself, in doing so, I had killed the person who was giving the Orcs orders on where to attack next. Seems to be a Thalmor agent. I should return to Kegor with the news.
objectives: Find out who the helping party is

title: From Dust
journal_entries: The guards talked of a nearby settlement called Sabbat having experienced a calamity, and from the sounds of things, it wasn't by any natural means. I should head towards this "Sabbat" and see what has occurred.
I stumbled upon a razed village, the scar that runs through it seems to be a result of magicka. Signs point me towards the mines that complete the scaffolding along the cliff face.
Upon reaching the mine, I recognize the small of ash and the tinge of conjuration filling the air, the source must be close. And to put an end to whatever force damned so many souls.
I should see if anyone has a reward for killing the necromancer on the bridge.
Entemon talked about seeing the Bishop at Evermore, to discuss any details pertaining to the necromancer group.

I talked to the bishop, and he told me of the fort in the mountain, Spinsters Peak he called it. It's entirely up to me if I make the venture to that den, against my better judgement I make my journey towards the fortress.
Some weird creature laid before me, slain by my hand. I sensed that it may have been the one coordinating this rabble. I should head back to the Bishop for some clarity.
objectives: Investigate the source of the undead
Follow up on the necromancers by speaking with the Priest in Evermore
Head to Spinsters Peak and investigate inside
Return to the Priest for more information
Follow what the note told you.

title: The hills have ice
journal_entries: Jarunsteg told me of a missing child who was apparently taken by the men in the mountain. He also told me not to inform Jannessa of his disappearance in fear that she may do something drastic, I'm to make my way up the mountain to search for his remains.

Unfortunately, the boy did not make it. I found his corpse within one of the giant sacks. I'm to return them back to Dunlain so the boy could have a proper burial instead of his bones being desecrated up in the mountains.
objectives: Return to Jarunsteg with the grim news

title: The Lure of Karim
journal_entries: Korvid worried that the corpse of Karim has been wrought into our realm once again, I agreed to investigate, but whether I'll reach the mad priest is down to luck, and the skills I possess.
First thing to do would be to find and destroy the priest's enraged daughter lest she takes the place of her maddened father.
Now I should delve deeper into the ruin and find any hint of the creatures existence.
Karina lays defeated, if I'm to end this ordeal I'll have to find karim and end his wretched existence. And hope that he never comes to breath our air again.
The specter is dead, in lack of a better term, and I have a bounty to collect.
objectives: Confirm the rumor of the Half-Breed's existence, and kill it
Go to korvid for the reward
Find Zinwe in regards to purchasing Greenmore Manor.
